caption: The drawing depicts a brown wooden corner cabinet with an upper and lower section. The upper section features two shelves with curved sides and a rounded top edge, backed by vertical wooden panels. The lower section is a closed cabinet with a single door, whose front and left side panels are decorated with stylized floral patterns in muted shades of yellow, green, and red. The door is bordered by a raised rectangular frame and includes a small round keyhole. The base of the cabinet is thick and molded, matching the molding along the cabinet's top edge. The cabinet is set against a light beige background with some subtle staining and scattered marks.
title: Hanging Corner Cupboard
